question: Can an autonomous native DSH optimizer discover useful plugin implementation/configuration/assembly changes under the fixed development contract?

dataExposure.origin: Synthetic public business mechanisms authored by this project. No official benchmark or customer workbooks.
dataExposure.optimizerAccess: Current development inputs, permitted traces, actual deliveries and independent aggregate/task feedback. No private grade source or expected values mounted.

selection: All four generator families in original manifest order, two repetitions each; no task selection based on this run outcomes.
qualityRule: Strictly larger full-denominator arithmetic mean; failure budget <=1 of 8. Other metrics report-only.
stop: At most four frozen candidates including seed, or explicit optimizer finish; optimizer container budget 1800 seconds. No identical-byte resampling, task retries or cherry-picking.
mutationPolicy: All six actions allowed. Optimizer chooses changes from evidence; no prescribed answer or required topology just to manufacture a success case.
claimsBoundary: Development outcomes only. A joint change may be an engineering observation; no causal, stable-gain or cross-domain claim follows from this experiment.
telemetry: Retain SDK adapter started/results/errors/unfinished and provider token reports for optimizer and executor, durations per candidate, all failures and auxiliary metrics. Unreported price or internal HTTP retries remain unknown.

specification.name: joint-plugin-research-20261027
specification.objective: Study general spreadsheet harness evolution using all fixed development tasks and independent feedback. Investigate capability boundaries, repeated work and failure mechanisms before choosing changes. You may jointly change plugin implementation, service configuration and assembly topology, including creating and recombining plugins when evidence supports it; all six mutation actions are available. Choose your mechanism rather than following a prescribed answer or target architecture. Produce genuine implementation experiments within the four-candidate budget, retain failures and negative results, and never resample unchanged bytes. Do not embed task coordinates, task identifiers or computed answers as special cases. Keep native DSH execution and fixed model weights. Correctness selects candidates; source preservation, time and cost are reported separately. A score tie or ceiling is a valid conclusion. This is development research, not independent held-out validation.

tasks.prompt: Complete /input/source.xlsx using Excel formulas. For every displayed year, normalize reported results by removing non-recurring expenses and gains. Begin with reported tax expense; each adjustment tax rate applies only to its own adjustment. Fill all four normalized metric rows for all years. Preserve all original inputs, labels, units and intentional blanks. Read original comments. Deliver /workspace/result.xlsx; an independent engine recalculates formulas. Python openpyxl and LibreOffice are installed.

Complete /input/source.xlsx using Excel formulas. Fill each segment revenue, gross profit and margin. Fill total units, revenue, gross profit and the portfolio margin. Total price and total cost per unit cells are intentionally blank; do not fill them. Preserve all original inputs, labels, units and intentional blanks. Read original comments. Deliver /workspace/result.xlsx; an independent engine recalculates formulas. Python openpyxl and LibreOffice are installed.

Complete /input/source.xlsx using Excel formulas. Build the four-year debt schedule. Repay equal principal installments each year, based on original principal. Interest uses the same-year opening balance and rate. Fill all five schedule rows for every year. Preserve all original inputs, labels, units and intentional blanks. Read original comments. Deliver /workspace/result.xlsx; an independent engine recalculates formulas. Python openpyxl and LibreOffice are installed.

Complete /input/source.xlsx using Excel formulas. Use the requested case to fill all forecast revenues and EBITDA. Then calculate exit enterprise and equity value in the final year only. Earlier-year exit value cells are intentionally blank. Preserve all original inputs, labels, units and intentional blanks. Read original comments. Deliver /workspace/result.xlsx; an independent engine recalculates formulas. Python openpyxl and LibreOffice are installed.
